weather.lead: Orlando looks sunny and dry Saturday and Sunday with highs near 80. A weak front Monday brings a 20% shower chance at Port Canaveral. Behind it, Castaway Cay turns breezy Tuesday with a west wind near 15 mph, and Lookout Cay stays near 81°F with a passing shower possible. No tropical storms are expected; a low south of Bermuda is moving east, away from our route. Forecasts past day 5 still shift, so check back here for updates.
